_source: wv-development src/main/java/xyz/iwolfking/woldsvaults/datagen/ModDeckCoresProvider.java + ModImplicitDeckCoresProvider.java (feature/hyper-objective, 2026-07-13). Keys match decks/wolds_decks.json values.* keys. Aggregation: additive into the per-card core sum (MixinCardDeck getModifierValue: 1 + sum(v-1)), EXCEPT kind=mirror which multiplies the whole per-card value (IMultiplicativeDeckModifier).

merchant.name: Merchant Deck Modifier
merchant.desc: +50% efficiency per Resource card in the same column

extended.name: Extended Deck Modifier
extended.desc: Increases vault duration contribution — no NDM effect

treasure.name: Treasure Deck Modifier
treasure.desc: +100% efficiency to Stat cards (shiny runs only — evo cards never carry Stat)

arcane.name: Arcane Deck Modifier
arcane.desc: +2 ability levels on arcane cards — no NDM effect

cactus.name: Cactus Deck Modifier
cactus.desc: +200% efficiency to cards that are BOTH Offensive and Defensive

cake.name: Cake Deck Modifier
cake.desc: +100% efficiency per row from the bottom (bottom row counts as 1)

puzzle.name: Puzzle Deck Modifier
puzzle.desc: +100% efficiency per orthogonally-adjacent card of a different color

mutant.name: Mutant Deck Modifier
mutant.desc: Stat cards: +25% efficiency per unique group in the deck (shiny runs only)

villager.name: Villager Deck Modifier
villager.desc: +300% efficiency to cards in arcane slots — arcane cards score 0 NDM, so no NDM effect

runic.name: Runic Deck Modifier
runic.desc: ×2 card value when the horizontally-mirrored slot holds a same-color card (center column always passes)

snake.name: Snake Deck Modifier
snake.desc: +7.5% efficiency per card in the same orthogonally-connected same-color chain (beyond the first)

shadow.name: Shadow Deck Modifier
shadow.desc: +15% efficiency per empty (dead) slot in the deck

relic.name: Relic Deck Modifier
relic.desc: Guaranteed tier-4 bounty crate — no NDM effect

mystery.name: Mystery Deck Modifier
mystery.desc: Two random implicits rolled from the other decks' pool at craft time — pick the pair your deck rolled
